description: Check whether a site started by create_site has finished. Signed in: pass the slug create_site returned (status building / built / failed). Guest build: pass the claim_token — works WITHOUT signing in. Poll this every 30-60 seconds rather than calling create_site again — a second create_site call builds a SECOND site.

claim_token.description: Guest builds: the claim_token from create_site.

slug.description: Signed in: the slug from create_site.

name: get_build_status
title: Check a site build
